profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, USA. It trades under the ticker COUR and has SEC Central Index Key 0001651562. The company describes itself as an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from partners including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford.

Its site highlights AI-related programs such as the Machine Learning Specialization, Deep Learning Specialization, AI Essentials Specialization, and AI Engineer Professional Certificate, as well as beginner-friendly Python and generative AI courses. The company also describes Coursera Plus, an annual subscription with unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

Legal exposure records list 281 California matters. No individual litigation cases or MCP servers are identified in the available records.
